target.title: Fix Claude never-prompt no-UI Keychain repair for missing credentials file (#1975)
target.body:
## Summary

- With the Claude provider's **Avoid Keychain prompts** setting (`claudeOAuthKeychainPromptMode = .never`), `shouldAllowClaudeCodeKeychainAccess` refused **all** `Claude Code-credentials` Keychain access unconditionally — including guaranteed no-UI reads (`KeychainNoUIQuery`, `kSecUseAuthenticationUI = .fail`). When `~/.claude/.credentials.json` goes missing after a Claude account switch, the existing no-prompt repair path (`repairFromClaudeKeychainWithoutPromptIfAllowed`) was blocked before it could read a still-valid Keychain token, surfacing **"Claude OAuth credentials not found"**.
- `.never` now means "no interactive prompts" rather than "no Keychain access at all": the gate takes an explicit `allowKeychainPrompt` flag and blocks `.never` only when the call site could actually show UI. This is the recommended option from the issue's triage review ("Allow no-UI fallback under `.never`").
- All 19 call sites of the gate were audited and classified individually: unconditionally non-interactive sites (repair, freshness sync, fingerprint/candidate probes via `KeychainNoUIQuery`, preflight-only pre-alert checks) pass `allowKeychainPrompt: false`; the interactive readers (`loadFromClaudeKeychain`, `loadFromClaudeKeychainWithPromptIfAllowed`, `securityFrameworkFallbackPromptDecision`) keep the default `true` and remain blocked under `.never`. `loadClaudeKeychainData`/`loadClaudeKeychainLegacyData` thread their existing `allowKeychainPrompt` parameter straight through.
- The **Advanced → Disable Keychain access** kill switch (`keychainAccessAllowed`) is checked before the mode switch and still hard-blocks everything, unchanged.
- Adjacent paths this also heals under `.never` (same class, all no-UI): OAuth strategy availability (`hasClaudeKeychainCredentialsWithoutPrompt`) now answers truthfully when only the Keychain holds credentials, and post-delegated-refresh silent sync (`syncFromClaudeKeychainWithoutPrompt`) can pick up the rotated token.

## Intentionally unchanged

- `shouldAttemptFreshnessSyncFromClaudeKeychain` and owner-resolution probing (`hasClaudeCLIStorageWithoutPrompt`) keep their explicit `.never` early-outs — #2011 deliberately minimized background Keychain IO under `.never`, and relaxing those is a separate product decision from this fail-closed repair gap.
- The `.never` interactive boundary itself: a prompting read is still refused even when a valid Keychain item exists (covered by a regression test).
- CodexBar-owned OAuth cache gating under `.never` (#2011) is untouched; its zero-IO regression tests still pass.

## Verification

- [x] `swift build` (all targets)
- [x] `swift test --filter ClaudeOAuthCredentialsStoreNeverPromptKeychainRepairTests` (3 new regression tests)
- [x] New tests verified to fail on pre-fix `main` (repair test throws `.notFound`, reproducing the exact reported error) and pass with the fix
- [x] `swift test --filter Claude` (509 tests / 82 suites; remaining failures are environment-only — PTY/subprocess suites that fail identically on unmodified `main` in the same headless SSH session)
- [x] `make test` (sharded suite runner)
- [x] `swiftformat --lint` + `swiftlint --strict` clean on changed files
- [x] Rebased on current `main`

Tests use the existing synthetic Keychain override hooks (`withClaudeKeychainOverridesForTesting`, `ClaudeKeychainOverrideStore`) and per-test isolated cache stores — no live Keychain access or prompts, per `AGENTS.md`.

## Behavior proof (synthetic fixtures, no live Keychain UI)

Repair path under `.never` with the credentials file missing and a valid synthetic Keychain payload:

```
◇ Test "never mode repairs a missing credentials file from a valid no-UI Keychain read" started.
info com.steipete.codexbar.claude-usage: interaction=background [CodexBarCore] Claude keychain credentials loaded without prompt; syncing OAuth cache
✔ Test "never mode repairs a missing credentials file from a valid no-UI Keychain read" passed
```

The record is returned with `source == .claudeKeychain`, `owner == .claudeCLI`. The same scenario on `main` throws `ClaudeOAuthCredentialsError.notFound` — the reporter's exact failure.

Fixes #1975
